answer: Claiming a work slot burns a 400 POA deposit before the tide of new agents can enter. Each slot is keyed to a rotating crystal; every finished job is signed with it, proving one agent did the work. Quit or fail and the deposit is gone. Forging 1,000 identities burns 400,000 POA while one slot pays 120 POA per epoch, so the attack loses at once. An honest agent pays once and earns back many times the deposit. The bridge admits only payers.
